Commentary.Commentary: That ends the ODI series in favour of the visiting side. Over now to white-ball cricket which starts from Thursday, 20th October, 2016 and will consist of 2 Tests. Do join us for all the action at 0930 IST (0400 GMT). Until then, Adios! Take Care!

Victorious England captain JOS BUTTLER is visibly happy. He says that his side stood up as a young one in physically and mentally tough conditions and the series win is a just reward for that. On the run chase, he says that when Billings and Duckett were playing, the win was setup there and they should have won by 7 or 8 wickets but is happy with the win nevertheless. On the toss, he says winning it was an advantage due to the inclement weather around. Says that he enjoyed playing in such a competitive series. Is proud to have captained such a talented group of players. Feels that to be the number 1 side in the world, one has to win in all conditions and feels that this series win helps England when they play in India next.

Bangladesh captain MASHRAFE MORTAZA says that the total was a decent one but the spinners could not get turn because of the dew. Compares the way both sides bowled, especially the spinners and says that they got more turn. Praises England for their win tonight and also says that they were the better team in the series. Is happy with a few individuals in the series and hopes for some consistency.

BEN STOKES has been named the MAN OF THE SERIES for scoring 148 runs at an average of 74. Says that the team showed what it can do if it can take the match to the very end. Adds that the purpose of this tour was to acclamatize to the Asian conditions and hopes to carry this experience into the Tests and later on, in the Indian tour. Feels happy to be recognized for his bowling changes in the first ODI and says that he and Buttler are naturally aggressive. Feels that if England continue playing this same way, then one day they will be on top of the world.

ADIL RASHID has been named the MAN OF THE MATCH for his 4/43 with the ball. He says that the ball came nicely out of his hand and is happy with the pitch that suited the spinners. Smiles on being asked about getting wickets on full tosses and short balls, saying that such deliveries too bring wickets. Credits the win and bowling to the positive mindset in the team. Hopes to play in Tests some day but feels that he has a long way to go still.

Earlier in the day, Bangladesh posted a competitive 277/6 on the board, riding on Mushfiqur Rahim's unbeaten 67 and useful contributions from the top order. They would have been very confident during the innings break but England had other ideas. Stay tuned for the presentation.

Disappointing bowling display by Bangladesh. Perhaps they were carried away with the amount of turn on the pitch and hence the spinners kept on bowling only arm balls, not allowing the ball to turn. Mosaddek Hossain got a wicket while Nasir got the first. In the middle, Shafiul got a couple and towards the end, Mortaza got a couple. But no one could string in a complete bowling performance.

Bairstow departed cheaply but Buttler and Stokes resisted the hosts with a 48-run stand for the 5th wicket. Bangladesh threatened to come back with Mortaza picking up the wickets of Buttler and Moeen in successive overs but Woakes then joined Stokes to steer England home, as the duo added an unbeaten 42 in just 32 balls for the 7th wicket.

It was a well-planned run chase. Like Bangladesh, England too got off to a cautious but positive start. They lost Vince just when he was looking to go big but importantly, did not allow a collapse to happen. Billings and Duckett scored useful half centuries and kept the visiting side in the hunt.

A fine, fine win for England. They would have been worried when they saw the target of 278 but this batting line-up has lost of positivity brewing around it. They have chased down the total with 13 balls to spare.

SIX! There is the game! A length ball outside off, Woakes comes forward and launches this miles over long off! The arms go aloft and Stokes hugs him. The crowd is stunned. ENGLAND WIN BY 4 WICKETS AND TAKE THE SERIES 2-1!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
WIDE. Another one, this time down the leg side.
Outside off, pushed to cover for a single.
WIDE. Getting sloppy now, Bangladesh. Shafiul bowls this miles outside off.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple. 9 more needed from 16 balls now.
SIX! Boom! Perhaps the killer blow. Full on middle, Stokes comes down the track and launches it miles straight down the ground! Moves to 44 from 46 balls. The stand is worth 31 from 28 balls.

FOUR! He continues to play his shots! Full and wide outside off, Woakes leans and crashes it through the covers for a boundary! 10 from the over. Woakes moves to 21 from 16 balls. 17 more needed from 18 balls now!
Outside off, a play and a miss.

DROPPED! Oh dear... that is a sitter. Full and outside off, Woakes looks to play another drive but this time gets an outside edge. It goes straight to Imrul Kayes at first slip but he fluffs it. Perhaps the last possible chance.
FOUR! Amazing! All that pressure being built up and Woakes calmly soakes it up. Leans into a full ball and drives it through the covers. The stand moves to 21 from 24 balls.

A desperate appeal for LBW but nothing in it. Pitched outside leg, Stokes missed his flick and the ball went off his pads to deep square leg. The umpire however, gave no signal of a leg bye. He felt it was bat.
Full and outside off, pushed down to mid off for a quick single.
TASKIN AHMED is back on.
Full and around off, Chris looks to flick but gets a leading edge which goes to third man. A single taken.
A swing and a miss this time! A length ball outside off, Woakes flashes but misses!
Play and a miss! Full and outside off, Woakes looks to push it away but the ball nips back in and goes past the inside edge and the off stump!
Full on middle, Stokes pushes it to long on for a single. 250 UP FOR ENGLAND.
Full and slightly wide outside off, Stokes slashes hard but misses.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
SHAFIUL ISLAM to have a go now...

Oohhh... full and straight, Stokes looks to flick but gets a leading edge which goes to mid off. They take a quick single. 29 needed from 30 balls now. Brave bowling from Mortaza. He was hobbling but still battled through to finish his quota of 10 overs. Finishes with figures of 10-1-51-2. Now can his bowlers win it for him?
Landed outside off, tapped down to third man for a single.
Outside off, played straight to point this time.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.

Full and wide outside off, Woakes goes hard at it and manages to squeeze it behind point. It should have been only a single but the fielder is a bit slow and Woakes charges back for the second. Moves to 10 from 5 balls. The stand is worth 11 from 11 balls.
Full and outside off, pushed towards covers.
Short and outside off, played behind point for one more.
Full on middle, Stokes misses his flick and gets a leading edge which goes behind point. A run taken.
Full and down the leg side, Stokes misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Nice yorker on middle, dug out to the bowler.

Full outside off, Woakes looks to drive it through the off side but the ball comes back in and goes off the inner half through mid on. The fielder dives over the ball and by the time he can recover, the batsmen take three.
A bit too late? A slip comes in now.

FOUR! Nicely done! Almost an action replay of Woakes' dismissal in the second ODI. Only this time, the ball went in the gap. In that game, Taskin got the ball to come back in and then tried to shape it away. Woakes was trying to run it down to third man and edged it to Rahim. Here, he played it a bit wide but wide of Rahim and got a boundary! Where is first slip? 38 more needed from 41 balls.
Landed outside off, played straight to point. What an over - just a run and a wicket from it. Mortaza has figures of 9-1-47-2!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short and outside off, cut straight to backward point.
CHRIS WOAKES walks in at number 8, replacing Moeen. England's batting line-up is strong but it is not easy for a new batsman to bat on such pitches.

OUT! Gone! Second wicket in two overs for Bangladesh! Are we seeing another turnaround? A length ball on middle, Moeen looks to puh it over mid on but it is half-hearted and he ends up spooning it high in the air. It does not have much distance and Mahmudullah back-pedals a bit from mid on and takes it calmly! ENGLAND NEED 42 FROM 45 BALLS!
UPPISH, BUT SAFE! Full on middle and off, Moeen pushes away from his body and chips it uppisly but it lands just short of short extra cover.
Around middle, turned towards square leg for a single.
Full on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. Two runs added to the total.
Outside off again, a swing and a miss this time.
On middle and leg, flicked away for a couple.
WIDE. Wide down the leg side, No trouble at all for the batsman. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Pushs at it meekly without moving his feet and almost nicks it behind as the ball moves away.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Short on middle, pulled towards square leg for a single.
MOEEN ALI walks in at number 7, replacing Buttler.

OUT! Chops it on! The skipper brings his side back into the game! A length ball outside off, Buttler looks to pull butthe ball bounces a fraction lesser, takes the inside edge ans cannons into the stumps! Do we have an opening? 51 MORE NEEDED FROM 56 BALLS!
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Bludgeoned! Short and outside off, Buttler cuts it through point and gets a boundary!
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a couple.
MASHRAFE MORTAZA brings himself back on.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full on middle, slower ball, Ben watches it, waits for it and then pushes it to mid on who dives to his right to stop the ball.
An appeal for a catch down the leg side, but nothing in it. Stokes missed his flick and Rahim appealed but it was very unconvincing. Erasmus had a look at his partner and signalled thigh pad.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.
A bit shortish now, Buttler pulls it to mid on for a quick single.
A bit of reverse, tailing into Buttler from outside off, fullish in length, Buttler just about manages to push it to mid on.
The game is slipping away from Bangladesh. They need a wicket or two quickly. TASKIN AHMED comes back on.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for a couple. 11 from the over. The stand is worth 41 from 34 balls. 58 needed from 66.
SIX! What a way to greet the changed ball! Tossed up on middle, Stokes comes down the track and swings it massively over long on! Moves to 25 from 21 balls.
The ball seems to have got discoloured. The umpires are having it changed.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a run.
Tha arm ball on middle and leg, Jos looks to work it to the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and outside off, Buttler comes down the track and drives it to ong off for a single.
Full toss on off, Stokes once again plays the reverse sweep but this time it's not in control. Goes on one bounce to short third man.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Wide! Quicker one fired down the leg side.

FOUR! Well played, Stokes! Tossed up ball around leg, Stokes gets into the position early for the reverse sweep and thumps it through the gap between short third man and backward point for a boundary.
Flighted ball on off, skidding in, Stokes advances down the track to drive it through covers but it comes off the inside edge and squirts to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Full floated on leg, pushed down through mid on for a single.
Slider on middle, skidding in, Stokes goes back and somehow keeps it out off the inside half of the bat. It rolls in the gap on the leg side and they cross for a single.
NASIR HOSSAIN is back on.
Presses forward to a full ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it through mid-wicket for a single. 200 up for England amidst a deafening silence.
Flatter and shorter on off, Buttler rocks back and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Flighted and full on middle, flicked past the right side of the mid-wicket fielder for a run.
Gets on the front foot and drives it through wide mid off for a single.
Flighted and full outside off, Buttler shapes up for a slog sweep but ends up pushing it back to the bowler on one bounce.
SHAKIB AL HASAN is back on. 82 needed off 84 balls.
Full and straight, eased through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and on off, defended back to the bowler.
On a length around off, angling in, Buttler turns it on the leg side but straight to short mid-wicket.

NOT OUT! Lands it full and outside off, Buttler bunts it to mid off and crosses for a quick single. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end, they appeal and the batsmen cross for an overthrow as well. It's referred upstairs and the replays found that Buttler was safely in.
Run out appeal taken upstairs...
Fullish and angling into the batsman, Jos pushes it off his pads to mid on. He was attempting to flick it through mid-wicket but closed the bat face early.
Length ball angling away from the batsman, Stokes stands back and hammers it to deep cover-point for one.
FOUR! Excellent shot by the English skipper! He attacks a full ball in his half and powers it over mid off. The fielder is inside the ring and the ball runs away to the fence.
Fullish outside off, driven straight to the cover fielder.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to covers where the ball finds Nasir Hossain.
Back of a length ball on off, Ben stays back and drags it through mid on for a run.
Stays back to a short ball and punches it through covers for one.

Angles across a fuller length ball on off, Stokes plays it with gentle hands to cover-point. It's straight to the fielder who has an unnecessary shy at the bowler's end and misses the stumps. They cross for an overthrow.
Pitches it full and outside off, Buttler drives it off his front foot to mid off and sends his partner back who was interested in a run.
FOUR! Shot! Back of a length ball around off, Buttler swivels on the back foot and nails his pull shot to the deep square leg fence.
Fullish and on the pads, nudged through mid-wicket for an easy run.
Fullish and around off, Buttler walks across the stumps and flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Skipper JOS BUTTLER arrives.

OUT! Massive breakthrough for Bangladesh as the batsman in form is gone! Shafiul runs in from around the wicket and angles in a fuller length ball on middle, Duckett shuffles across the stumps and attempts to play the paddle scoop. But he ends up playing it too close to the keeper who dives to his right and takes a stunning catch. Well, well, well, this game is turning around now. 99 needed off 101 balls!
Straighter in line, worked to the left side of the mid on fielder for a brisk single.

Risky single! Length ball on off, again slower in pace, Stokes taps it down in the gap at covers and hurries to the other end. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but fails to find the stumps. Could have been touch and go.
Slower delivery, full and around middle and leg, Stokes once again defends it back with a straight bat.
Fuller in length and around off, Stokes gets forward and defends.
Fetches a length ball from wide outside off and heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length ball on middle, Stokes turns inside the crease and glances it over square leg for a single.
Starts this spell with a fuller length ball on middle and off, Stokes gets on the front foot and defends it back.
MASHRAFE MORTAZA is back on.

Not out! Fuller length ball angling into the batsman, Stokes bunts it down the ground towards mid off and scampers across for a quick single. There is a direct hit at the bowler' end, they appeal and it's referred upstairs. The replays show that Stokes is well in.
Run out appeal is referred upstairs...

Nearly drags it on! Shafiul angles in a length ball from wide of the crease, Duckett goes for a heave but gets an inside edge on it. The ball goes closely past the stumps and Stokes calls him through for a single.
A touch short and outside off, Duckett punches it away from his body but fails to find the gap at covers.
Good length delivery angling away from the batsman, Stokes stays back and pushes it through the gap at covers for a single. Gets off the mark and will be relieved. Bagged a duck in the second ODI!
BEN STOKES is the new batsman.
Drinks break.

OUT! Sound of timber! A much-needed breakthrough for the Bangla Tigers and the crowd is suddenly back into it. Shafiul returns to over the wicket for the right-hander and angles in a length ball around off. Bairstow plays all over it, swings his bat way too early and hence fails to make any connection. He turns back to look behind and finds his stumps shattered. 106 needed off 112 bals!
Short of a length delivery outside off, from around the wicket, Ben slaps it square of the wicket on the off side for a run.
Turns it off his pads to the leg side for a run.

RUN OUT CHANCE MISSED! Bairstow lunges to defend and keeps it out off the inside half of the bat. It rolls on the leg side and they cross for a quick single. Rahim immediately gets to the ball, turns and has a shy but fails to connect at the striker's end. Direct hit would have consumed Duckett!
The batsman plays a sweep shot. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Another great shot by Ben! He shimmies down the track to a full ball and lofts it cleanly over mid off for a boundary. Smart batting!

FOUR! Tossed up ball on off, fuller in length, Duckett goes down on one knee and sweeps it firmly over square leg. Nasir Hossain sprints across to his right from fine leg, puts in a dive but fails to keep it in. Good effort but in vain!
Tossed up ball on off, it's driven off the front foot through mid off for a single.
SHAKIB AL HASAN is brought back into the attack. 119 needed off 120 balls.
Outside off on a length, punched from the back foot to covers.
Forces a full ball to mid on where the fielder makes a tumbling stop.
Shortish and outside off, punched firmly from the crease to the cover fielder.
Bairstow plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SECOND ODI FIFTY FOR BEN DUCKETT!

Fifty for Ben! What a knock by the young man. He showed his class in the first ODI as well but this knock he will rate higher as it has come under pressure of a run chase. Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single. Raises his bat towards his dressing room. The crowd keeps mum!
Fullish and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
SHAFIUL ISLAM is back on.

Shout for an lbw! Nasir bowls it full and around off, Ben fails to middle his attempted sweep shot and is hit on the pads. They appeal and the batsmen cross three times. Signalled as runs so maybe there was some inside edge.
Goes deep inside the crease and helps it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter off spinner on middle, it's punched from the crease to mid-wicket.
Fires a full ball down the leg side, Duckett gets across the stumps and spoons it down to fine leg for three runs.
Quicker full ball on off, skidding in, it's hit across the line but straight to mid-wicket.
Walks down the track and punches a shortish ball to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on middle, it's reverse swept through point for a single.
Another excellent footwork, this time by Ben as he jumps out of the crease and chips it with the spin over covers for a couple of runs.
Knocks a full ball down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Fine, fine shot! Hossain bowls it from around the wicket and lands it fuller outside off, Jonny advances down the track and lofts it with ease over mid off for a boundary.
Loopy full ball outside off, Jonny fetches it from there and paddles it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Flatter off spinner outside off, Bairstow gets forward and defends it to the of side.
MOSADDEK HOSSAIN is back on.

A mishit but safe! Tossed up ball on middle, spinning away a shade, Duckett once again goes for the slog sweep but this time fails to get hold of his shot. It catches the top edge, balloons in the air and luckily for him falls in the no man's land in the deep mid-wicket region. Two runs added to the total.
Loopy full ball on off, Jonny jumps out of the crease and eases it through mid on for one.
Flatter one, full and on middle, played off the pads to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on middle and off, it's driven through mid off for a single.
Advances down to the pitch of the ball and defends it back.
FOUR! Up and over! Flighted off spinner around off, Duckett goes down on one knee and slogs it against the spin. It's aerial but out of the reach of the fielder inside the ring.
NASIR HOSSAIN is back on.
Pushes this towards mid on for a quick single.
Full and outside off, Duckett drives it straight back and the bowler does well to stop it in his follow-through.
Short and outside off, cut fiercely behind point for a single.
Full and outside off, Jonny looks to drive straight but the ball comes back in, takes the inside edge, goes onto the ground and hits him on the pads. Lobs wide off the bowler.
Landed outside off, Bairstow has a play and a miss.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total. 4 runs and a wicket from the over. Mosaddek fulfils his captain's wish of a breakthrough. 3-0-12-1 so far.

Flicks it to short fine leg and has a look at the fielder. Bairstow comes charging in for the single and is in trouble as Duckett is ball-watching. There is a run out opportunity but the fielder fumbles and now they get a single. 149 more needed from 151 balls now.
Goes back and punches it down to long on for a run. Gets off the mark.
JONNY BAIRSTOW walks in at number 4, replacing Billings.

OUT! There comes the breakthrough! Is this going to be the turning point of the game? Full and around off, Billings gets down and looks to play the sweep. His intention is to direct it towards fine leg but the bat swings a bit quicker than he wants to. As a result, he gets a bit of a top edge which sails down perfectly into the hands of Imrul Kayes at deep square leg who does not have to move an inch. Billings gets down on his haunches in disappointment. Has he let Bangladesh back into the game? Only time will tell. He departs for 62 and the 64-run stand is broken. ENGLAND NEED 151 FROM 153 BALLS.
Slightly fuller, Ben gets down and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Short and around middle, Duckett backs away and heaves it straight to short mid-wicket.
MOSADDEK HOSSAIN is back on.
Well bowled. Lands it a bit wider outside off, around the length between full and good, Billings looks to run it down to third man but misses.
Short and around off, SB pulls it through squae leg and hares back for a couple.
Full and outside off, defended nicely with a walk.
That landed on a good length around off, Sam adjusts nicely to the extra bounce and fends it off to point.

Hmm.... a bouncer outside off, seaming away, Billings thinks about the pull but then pulls out of the shot. He is surprised when there is no signal for a wide and smilingly asks the umpire about the same. That really looked like it went above the head.
Full and outside off, blocked straight to short extra cover.
Drops it short, Ben pulls it through mid-wicket for a brace again. The stand is worth 61 from 68 balls. Duckett moves to 30 from 39 balls.
On middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Back of a length outside off, Duckett flashes but misses.
On middle and leg, tucked to deep square leg for a single.
Comes down the track and swings hard but misses.
TOP EDGE, FOUR! A short ball outside off, Billings swings wildly and gets a top edge which flies over the vacant slip cordon to beat third man. 159 more needed from 167 balls.
That is hard luck. Full and off, Billings drves it powerfully straight back but it is so straight that it hits the stumps at the other end and deflects wide of mid on. Just a single.
Short and outside off, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Goes back and pushes it to cover this time.
Short and outside off, bunted back to the bowler.
50-run stand up in 58 balls!

Terrific fielding. On a good length otuside off, Sam pushes it towards long off but Shakib Al Hasan dives to his right from short extra cover. He tries to pick up and throw in one motion and misses his shy at the bowler's end. Billings was in anyways.
Flashy. A full ball outside off, Billings throws his bat at it but there is no feet movement and he misses.
Good length ball on off, Duckett pushes it towards mid off.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Duckett tries to flick but misses. Wide signaled.
Landed outside off, Sam punches it through covers for a single.

NOT OUT! Good length ball outside off, rather a touch fuller, Billings comes forward to play it across but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a big appeal for a leg before but the umpire says it not out. Bangladesh choose to review. Replays show the impact is umpire's call. Billings survives and Bangladesh lose their review. The crowd thinks it's out as the ball would have hit the stumps but it doesn't know the impact is umpire's call, which is not out.
Review against Sam Billings! Bangladesh feel they have their man. The umpire hasn't given it out LBW so they have chosen to review.
Fuller length ball on off, driven through mid off for a single.
On middle and off, Duckett tries to flick but gets a leading edge.
Back of a length ball on off, Billings punches it away off his back foot to covers for a single.
SHAFIUL ISLAM comes back to bowl.
On middle and off, Duckett flicks it to square leg.
In the corridor outside off, Duckett gets beaten now.
Fuller length ball on off, Duckett drives it to wide mid off.
Back of a length ball outside off, Billings gets onto his front foot and pushes it to cover-point for a single.
There's a slip in place now for Billings...
Good length ball outside off, bit of an extra bounce, Billings tries to push but gets beaten yet again.
Landed outside off, Billings tries to push but fails to put his bat on the ball.
Maiden ODI fifty for Sam Billings!
Landed around off, Billings pushes it to covers for a quick single. That brings up his fifty as well. Impressive knock, this.
On the pads, Billings works it to fine leg and takes a couple.
Fullish outside off, Billings drives it to covers where the fielder fumbles a bit.
Shortish outside off, Duckett cuts it through backward point for a single.
Tossed up ball outside off, Duckett flicks it to mid-wicket again.
WIDE! Angles it down the leg side, Duckett tries to flick but misses. The umpire signals a wide.
Landed around off, Duckett works it to mid-wicket.
This is interesting. Sam Billings has gone on to better this previous innings' score each time he has come out to the crease.
Flatter outside off, Duckett comes down the track and pushes it to long off. Single taken.
FOUR! Good shot! Fullish outside off, Duckett reverse sweeps it over backward point. The fielder tries to chase the ball but fails. 100 UP FOR ENGLAND!
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Outside off, BD comes down the track and pushes it to long off for a single.
Landed outside off, Duckett reverse sweeps it through point for a couple. Not the best of the efforts there by the fielder.
Billings comes down the track to play this one and takes it on the full, the ball goes off the leading edge to the off side. Single taken though.
Landed outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
On middle and off, Billings defends it with soft hands.
Shortish outside off, Duckett plays it through point for a single.
Tossed up ball outside off, Duckett comes down the track and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Fullish outside off, Billings drives it through mid off for a single.
On middle and off, Duckett comes down the track and plays it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
SHAKIB AL HASAN comes back on.
Driven through mid off by Ben for a single to end the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman dances down the track and plays it to long off. Two runs added to the total.
On middle and off, Duckett covers the line and defends.
SIX! Wonderful shot! Fullish ball on off, Duckett gets down on his knee and slog sweeps it over long on. The ball goes all the way for a biggie.
Fullish outside off, Billings reverse sweeps it through point for a single.
Fullish ball outside off, driven to mid off. There is a fielder.
Driven through mid on by Sam for another single.
Fullish ball around off, Duckett drives it through mid on for a single yet again.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Shortish outside off, Duckett cuts it through point for a single.
Tad short outside off, Billings punches it to long on for a single.
Around off, Ben comes down the track and defends.

NOT OUT! On middle and leg, Billings works it to short fine leg and sets off. There is a throw at the striker's end where Duckett tries to make it in with a dive. Replays show it's close but he just manages to make it back. Risky run taken.
There is an appeal for a run out at the striker's end. Duckett could be a goner here. It has been referred upstairs. Touch and go.

FOUR! Fullish ball outside off, Billings gets into the position and reverse sweeps it through the point region. Shafiul fielding in the deep puts in a dive but only manages to parry the ball to the fence eventually.
Pushed through covers by Duckett for a single.
Fullish outside off, Duckett drives it to covers.
On middle and leg, Billings pushes it uppishly to long on for a single.
Landed on off, Duckett looks to push but misses and gets hit on the pads. Stifled appeal for an LBW turned down.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter one outside off, pushed to covers by Duckett.
Fullish ball around off, Billings sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Outside off, Duckett plays it uppishly through point for a single.
Tad short on off, Billings punches it away off his back foot to long on for a single.
MOSADDEK HOSSAIN to bowl now.
Outside off, Duckett punches it away off his back foot. Successful over for Bangladesh!
Landed outside off, Duckett pushes it to covers.
BEN DUCKETT walks in at number 3, replacing Vince.

OUT! LBW! This time Vince has to go! Flighted ball outside off, turns in, Vince gets too across to play this one but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a loud shout and the umpire raises his finger this time. Bangladesh finally get the breakthrough. Vince has a chat with his partner and decides not to take a review. Looked out to naked eye!
Appeal for an LBW! Flighted outside off, Vince tries to play it across but misses and gets hit on the pads. The umpire says not out as the impact could be outside off.

Interesting stat. Since the Asia Cup in 2014, Bangladesh have lost just one ODI after scoring 250 or more in the first innings. That came against New Zealand in Hamilton in the 2015 World Cup. They have played 13 proper 50-over matches in this period.
FOUR! Two in two! Fuller length ball outside off, Vince drives it through the extra cover region. The ball goes right through the gap between the cover and mid off fielder for another boundary.
FOUR! Timing! Good length ball outside off, Vince punches it through point. Beats the fielder there and the ball races away to the fence.
Play and a miss! Length ball outside off, Vince goes for the cut but misses. Some extra bounce there.

MIX UP! Oh dear! Landed outside off, Billings steers it to third man and says yes for two. But as soon as he turns around from the non-striker's end, he collides with Mortaza. So he says no for the run but Vince from the other end had already left and he has to rush back. Luckily for him the throw is pretty wide at the striker's end and he has time to get back. Now, now, now! There are some words being shared between Mortaza and Billings. The umpire has to calm things down.
